item.title: Where Australia Small Businesses Waste Their Marketing Budget
item.summary: Small business owners in Australia spend thousands of dollars every year on marketing, and a large part of that money rarely brings customers. A boosted Facebook post, a print flyer, or a random freelance website often feels like marketing, but without tracking or a clear plan, it is closer to guessing than growing.
